split_rule: worker_minor = price_minor * 9000 / 10000 (integer floor); pool_minor = price_minor - worker_minor; verifiers ordered by id; first n-1 receive pool_minor / n; last receives pool_minor / n + pool_minor % n; pending hold = worker_minor + pool_minor = price_minor; platform retains 0
